{{Quote|The true Emperor expects you all to remember your duty and obey.|Edouard Fenel|<ref name="Legacy 36" />}}
'''Edouard Fenel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] who was loyal to [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. Fenel was placed in command of the [[Bastion Second Fleet]].

==History==
{{Quote|We're going to stop shooting for the moment, and so are you. Then you're going to patch me through to all of your ship&mdash;all level&mdash;or I'm going to blow you to atoms.''"<br />"''Do it. Patch him through.|Edouard Fenel and Peto Kelsan|<ref name="Legacy 36" />}}
Edouard Fenel served the [[Fel Empire]] during the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] commanded the starship [[Resolute (Fel Empire)|''Resolute'']] during the [[Battle of Caamas]], where he was responsible for, in [[Gar Stazi]]'s words, "picking off cruisers too heavily damaged to put up a fair fight."<ref name="Legacy 36" />

Fenel ultimately decided to support Emperor Fel. Fenel was commander of the [[Bastion Second Fleet]] when the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] and [[Empire-in-exile]] agreed to work together against the [[One Sith|Sith]]. When the first joint operation was decided on, Fel chose Fenel to lead the forces loyal to his empire in the battle alongside Stazi. Stazi suspected that Fel assigned Fenel to test him and the Remnant.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

During the [[Battle of Ralltiir (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Ralltiir]], Fenel and Stazi pitted their fleets against the Sith's [[Coruscant Third Fleet]]. There were two objectives to this battle: capture the Sith fleet and force the Sith to extend their forces thinner. During the battle, Fenel told Admiral [[Peto Kelsan|Kelsan]] to surrender [[Darth Krayt]]'s fleet or be destroyed, and even encouraged mutiny if the ship's officers refused to do so. Kelsan agreed to surrender.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

The plan began to fall apart when [[Vaclen Tor]], [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Steadfast (Ardent-class)|''Steadfast'']], refused to surrender and called on the rest of the Third Fleet to self-destruct their ships and escape. Fenel advocated Tor’s crew to mutiny against him, but the crew was loyal to their commanding officer. In response, Fenel ordered all Imperial ships, including the surrendering Imperial fleet, to destroy the ''Steadfast. H''owever, Fenel’s ruthlessness encouraged Kelsan to order self-destruction instead of surrendering. Fenel ordered his forces to destroy the escape pods and destroy the remaining ship, but Stazi had had enough of Fenel's ruthless tactics. Stazi placed his fleet between Fenel and Kelsan's fleets and ordered his fleet to obliterate Fenel's forces if any of them shot at their forces. Stazi allowed Kelsan's crews to evacuate their ships and detonate them.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

However, the ''Steadfast'' had been damaged by Fenel's barrage&mdash;their escape pods and self-destruct systems were disabled. Fenel, after finding this out, ordered his forces to destroy Tor's vessel. He advised Stazi to pull his own forces away from the ''Steadfast'', but Stazi refused to back down. He ordered his fleet to fire a barrage of blocking fire between Fenel's fleet and Tor's vessels, prompting Fenel to call off the attack. Roan Fel later apologized to Stazi for Fenel's tactics, saying he thought Fenel understood the situation better than he really did.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Remind me why I shouldn't shove a barrage up his arrogant exhaust port, Captain Bey?''"<br />"''Because it would be counterproductive to our new alliance with his master. Although, I wonder why they sent such a drutash grub to our first joint mission.''"<br />"''As I said before, this is a test. And Roan Fel is testing me. If I can deal with Fenel, I can probably deal with any of his officers. So let's deal.|Admiral Gar Stazi and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jhoram Bey]]|<ref name="Legacy 36" />}}
Edouard Fenel believed that Roan Fel was the rightful Emperor, and therefore supported him when the Sith seized control of the Empire. However, Fenel was ruthless when it came to dealing with his Emperor's enemies, even willing to use the Sith's own brutal tactics against them. He was also very critical of the Galactic Alliance, particularly Gar Stazi, as he insulted him regularly when they were working together.<ref name="Legacy 36" />

==Behind the scenes==
Edouard Fenel was introduced in the 36th issue of ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', [[Legacy (2006) 36|''Renegade'']], published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The character was drawn by [[Omar Francia]] and colored by [[Brad Anderson]].<ref name="Legacy 36" />
